title: Nkonimdifo a Wɔbɛsan Akɔ Akyi
intro: Wɔ ɔsoro adom ho abakɔsɛm mu no, ɔkra bi a ne ho tew a ɛso bi nni wɔ hɔ, a wɔayi no afi wɔn nkurɔfo ho sɛ ɔnhwehwɛ ankonamyɛ wɔ ɔkwan kronkron bi so. Na wonnim sɛ saa tew a wɔbɛtew wɔn ho yi de sɛnkyerɛnne bi bɛba ama wiase nyinaa, gyidi sɔhwɛ a wɔbɛka ho asɛm daa.
clues: Mihyiraa me ho so maa ɔsom asetra ansa na wɔrewo me.
Wɔde me hyɛɛ odiyifo anuonyam bi hwɛ ase.
Wɔde aduane a ɛfiri Allah hɔ a ɛmaa me hwɛfoɔ no ho dwiriw me na ɛboaa me.
Metwee me ho fii m’abusua ho kɔɔ apuei fam beae bi.
Ɔbɔfo bi yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ me a ɔte sɛ onipa a ɔyɛ pɛ, na ɔde ɔba kronn ho amanneɛbɔ brɛɛ me.
Bere a me ne me ba a wɔawo no foforo san bae no, me nkurɔfo bɔɔ me sobo, nanso akokoaa no kasa de yii me ano.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verse: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. (19:16)
